title: Novel settings: language + UX options
notes: Add novel-writing settings that are explicitly separate from UI language: novel language, tone, target length, POV, etc. Persist via `/api/settings` under a `novel` namespace and expose in PWA Settings UI (without changing UI labels).
acceptance: Settings persist under settings.novel.* and survive backend restart
Changing UI language does not change novel language setting and vice versa
PWA displays and edits novel settings via /api/settings
